title: Wasserstein Exponential Smoothing for Distributional Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2606.05560v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Distributional time series arise when each temporal observation is a probability distribution rather than a scalar. We propose Wasserstein exponential smoothing (WES), a one-parameter recursive forecasting method for distributional time series on $\mathbb{R}$. The method adapts the practical logic of classical exponential smoothing to probability distributions by updating forecast distributions along Wasserstein geodesics. This yields a simple filter that can be applied directly to empirical distributions without parametric density modeling. We estimate the smoothing parameter by minimizing an in-sample Wasserstein prediction loss and establish consistency under a distributional local-level data-generating process. translated_title: 瓦瑟斯坦指数平滑法用于分布时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 分布时间序列是指每个时间观测值是一个概率分布而非标量的情况。我们提出了瓦瑟斯坦指数平滑法（WES），这是一种用于定义在实数域上的分布时间序列的单参数递归预测方法。该方法通过沿瓦瑟斯坦测地线更新预测分布，将经典指数平滑的实用逻辑适配到概率分布上。这产生了一个简单的滤波器，可直接应用于经验分布，无需参数密度建模。我们通过最小化样本内瓦瑟斯坦预测损失来估计平滑参数，并在分布局部水平数据生成过程下建立一致性。在高频股指收益分布和家庭电力需求分布的应用中，WES在现有分布自回归方法中实现了最低的一步前瓦瑟斯坦预测误差。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于瓦瑟斯坦测地线的单参数指数平滑方法，可直接应用于经验分布进行分布时间序列预测，并在实证中取得最优预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a one-parameter exponential smoothing method based on Wasserstein geodesics, applicable directly to empirical distributions for distributional time series forecasting, achieving optimal predictive performance in empirical studies.
